Fraser M
4 contributions

Kim’s gang made my day @lasiestapremier
May 2026 • Business
After a long and very hot day I found my way to the 10th floor Skybar. It has two levels - the top has great views over the inner city. Kim recommended the beef cheek - I’ve eaten a lot of pork and duck this week (& amazing Vietnamese fresh bread) so her recommendation was perfect. Slow cook with so much flavour. After I asked if they could make a cocktail for me - we all need to spoil ourselves sometimes - and they came up with an amazing gold rum based drink with a bitter sweet passionfruit and a touch of cacao - the service here is extraordinary. I feel very appreciated as a solo business traveller just relaxing at the end of the day.
Read more
Written May 27, 2026
EHG-Group
Dear Fraser,
Thank you for your wonderful review and for choosing Aqua Sky Bar.

We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your time with us after a long day and that our rooftop views provided the perfect setting to relax.
